description: press5 Play's server engines, which run a game's rules on press5 so nobody can cheat: arena (real-time action), turns (board and card games), party (quizzes and polls). For each: what it is for, the input and actions a game sends, the events and view it gets back, and its settings as JSON Schema with defaults and limits. Pick one in press5.game.json's "server" block. No account needed.
